statistical_design.duplicate_scope: Record duplicate outputs without silently changing the unit. Independent RNG-draw slots may remain valid draw trials. Deduplicating selected finite-pool slots changes the sampling design and cannot retain the original pool size.
statistical_design.role_strategy: All current42 IDs become legacy development/reuse for a new physics study. Freeze new ancestor/generator configuration and seed provenance before payload/outcome inspection. Known original ancestors cannot straddle roles. Hold whole source/generator settings out when claiming unseen-setting transfer; new draws within known settings support conditional synthetic-draw confirmation only. Keep per-setting confirmation and descriptive named-benchmark cases separate; no slice-IID or pooled-site claim.
statistical_design.unit: entire original base model / verified independent procedural draw, including every slice/source/frequency/state/iteration; group reused ancestors before any split
statistical_design.zero_failure_one_sided_95_upper_formula: 1 - 0.05**(1/n); ONLY for predeclared independent identically distributed model-event trials
